professional_summary.content: Sabrina (chronological age: 2 years, 10 months) was assessed using multiple standardized pediatric assessment tools to evaluate developmental functioning across cognitive, motor, sensory processing, and communication domains. The comprehensive evaluation revealed both areas of emerging developmental skills such as social engagement and learning potential, and areas requiring targeted intervention support, notably fine motor coordination, attention and focus, and communication skills. These challenges impact her functional performance and daily activities, particularly in her ability to interact effectively and participate fully in age-appropriate tasks. A multidisciplinary intervention approach involving occupational therapy, speech-language pathology, and behavioral therapy is recommended to address these concerns and support her optimal developmental trajectory. With early and consistent interventions, Sabrina is expected to make meaningful gains, enhancing her functional independence. Engaging the family in the therapeutic process and providing education will be crucial to achieving long-term developmental success. Regular monitoring and reassessment will be important to track her progress and modify intervention strategies to align with her evolving needs.
